scope: Read-only forensic paper, recipe, representation/objective, scientific claims and raw outcome audit. Only this file written.

executive_summary.verdict: Useful debugging and a documented negative/partial recovery result; no good SmolVLM policy, no demonstrated n0008 architectural benefit, and no paper-comparable retained-success result.
confirmed: Main final experiment: B16 475/500,Q8 474/500,Q4 479/500,S500 11/500, independently recounted.
Late GPU pipeline double-rescales images; corrected input plus broader adaptation yields partial LIBERO functionality.
Expanded development: corrected parent31/100 versusB16 82/100, with0 Smol-only successes.
Final all-decoder/query follow-up: selected9.5k;5/10 versus matched parent4/10 on repeatedly inspected states.
Latest closeout generally reports these limits accurately; no fabricated material counts found.
plausible_explanations: Generic frozen SmolVLM and nonspecialized query rows feeding heads pretrained with Qwen representations.
Much lower adaptation exposure and optimization differences than the paper.
Tiling/prompt workload, systematic action error and stochastic gripper outputs can impair efficiency or feedback control.
unknowns: Whether a correctly processed root with the same training recipe would equal or beatn0008.
Which coupled intervention produced partial recovery.
Whether a properly trained SmolVLM transplant can meet90% final success; these runs cannot answer capacity.
Whether final query gain generalizes beyond the ten reused diagnostic states.
executive_summary.value_assessment: The money bought real defects, retained artifacts, and stronger negative evidence. It did not buy the requested competitive policy. Core quantization evidence is the clearest class-project deliverable; lengthy optional recovery should be a bounded appendix, with no additional spending inferred from this audit.

sources.verified_facts: Current LIBERO configuration: per-device batch eight, maximum 120k steps, 20k warmup, no frozen modules; Qwen learning rate 1e-5, action 1e-4, predictor 5e-4; pretrained-stage initialization. Action horizon seven, four inference steps, three latent token types repeated eight times and 32 embodied tokens. This differs from the appendix; the recipes must not be combined.

SmolVLA 450M achieves 90% LIBERO-Spatial without robotics pretraining in its simulation table. The simulation recipe freezes the VLM and trains 100k updates at batch 64. It uses earlier features, global images without tiling, a different action expert and feedback after each action. This shows compact frozen SmolVLM control can work, not that this transplant should equal it.

paper_comparability.direct_verdict: This is a defensible comparison of practical deployment configurations under a restricted adaptation budget. It is not a fair controlled substitution for estimating the effect of backbone capacity, and it is not a reproduction of the original paper training experiment.
paper_comparability.project_recipe: B16 restores the complete published LIBERO policy. S500 starts from generic SmolVLM2 plus compatible action/world weights from the pretraining artifact, freezes SmolVLM and newly added query rows, and adapts the interface and heads for 10k updates at batch two. Recovery subsequently changes processing, decoder trainability, optimizer, schedule and exposure.
paper_comparability.paper_recipe: The cited appendix reports 50k joint pretraining updates and 30k simulation updates at global batch 256, with VLM adaptation and learned query tokens. The inspected author LIBERO YAML instead specifies a 120k maximum, batch eight per device and different warmup and predictor learning rate. The actual exact recipe behind the converted published checkpoint is not independently established here.
paper_comparability.interpretation: The exposure ratios are arithmetic descriptions of total anchor-frame presentations. They cannot prove undertraining, or serve as compute, unique-example or per-task exposure ratios, because corpus and sampling differ. The project tests LIBERO-Spatial only; paper-wide claims across four suites and other simulators are not reproduced.
paper_comparability.defect_causality: The processor argument repair restores contrast and the native-buffer loader repairs a numerical reconstruction mismatch. Neither repair has an isolated matched closed-loop experiment proving it explains the large control gap. The RoPE pair explicitly showed no aggregate improvement; the successful RGB recovery couples multiple changes.
